summary: Round 5 ships /seo-command-center — an internal, Clerk-authed ops app for the agentic-seo-loop, plus a local Node backend that spawns the round-4 workers and streams their stdout via SSE. Backend is fully live-verified against real endpoints: 46 aggregated keywords across 8 past runs, 65 site pages with 32 CMS-owned (Post 4, Technology 10, Industry 18, UseCase 0, CaseStudy 0), 68 built routes with unique titles + zero multi-h1 offenders. Hygraph schema was live-introspected — the real JEDI Labs schema has NO nested `seo` model, so cms-injector was rewritten to mutate flat title/description-equivalent fields per model. The round-4 LLM regression (spaCy's NLP-library description replaced with generic Jedi Labs marketing copy) was fixed by rewriting buildEditPrompt to be page_kind-aware with an explicit truth rule that preserves accurate product descriptions on /technology/* pages. Re-tested live against Gemini 2.5 Flash: the model now returns 'Explore spaCy, an open-source Python library for advanced NLP…' with tokenization/POS/NER intact.

cms_injector_rewrite.what_changed: Was written against an assumed nested `seo { title description }` field pattern. Live introspection showed JEDI Labs' Hygraph schema has NO nested seo model. Rewritten to target flat model-specific title/description-equivalent fields.

features.preflight: Live-introspects schema, checks every ROUTE_MODEL's target fields exist, writes cms-schema-preflight.json
features.buffered_writes: S3 FUSE mounts silently drop appendFileSync — all preview/applied/skipped entries buffered in memory arrays and flushed with single writeFileSync at end
features.preview_only_mode: Default is dry-run: real Hygraph lookup, real GraphQL mutation drafted, but NOT executed. --apply flag needed to run mutations.
features.publish_mutation_drafted: Publish step included in preview so operator sees the full state transition

cms_injector_rewrite.verified_end_to_end: POST /api/workers/cms-injector/run with { runDir: <round4>, previewOnly: true } returned exit 0 in 3s. Preflight report: all 5 models present, 0 problems. Real Hygraph lookup found Technology record cm5bxov6r1xhc07loztif3ksd for slug 'spacy'.

analyst_prompt_tune.regression_fixed: Round 4 replaced spaCy's factual NLP-library description ('spaCy is an open-source library for advanced NLP in Python…') with generic Jedi Labs marketing copy. This was a truth violation, not an SEO win.
analyst_prompt_tune.fix_approach: buildEditPrompt is now page_kind-aware. Route → kind detection (technology, use-case, case-study, industry, blog-post, static). Per-kind truth rules make explicit what MUST be preserved.
analyst_prompt_tune.technology_truth_rule: Preserve the accurate product description — what it is, what it does technically, its actual capabilities. Do NOT replace the technical description with generic 'Jedi Labs solutions' copy. Do NOT invent usage claims — e.g. do NOT write 'used for X' if the original description doesn't already establish that use.
analyst_prompt_tune.verified_live: Re-tested against Gemini 2.5 Flash with the exact spaCy input from round 4. Model now returns: 'Explore spaCy, an open-source Python library for advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP). It offers pre-trained models for tokenization, POS tagging, and NER.' — tokenization/POS/NER preserved, keyword targeted, title polished to 'spaCy: Advanced NLP in Python | Jedi Labs' at 41 chars. Confidence 0.95.

worker_smoke_tests.analyst: Real Semrush call: 'ai evaluation' US volume=70 kdPct=100%. Real Gemini call: title='AI Evaluation & Research | About Jedi Labs', 0 retries, model=gemini-2.5-flash. Exit 0 in 2.4s.
worker_smoke_tests.cms_injector: Real Hygraph lookup for slug=spacy → id cm5bxov6r1xhc07loztif3ksd. Preflight: 5 models present, 0 schema problems. Real GraphQL mutation drafted for both update + publish. Exit 0 in 3s. Buffered writes bypassed S3 FUSE appendFileSync limitation.

known_limitations.browser_test_gap: Panels compile via esbuild + serve via Vite HMR (HTTP 200 on all URLs). Backend endpoints all return the correct data shape. But panels have NOT been rendered in a headless browser end-to-end — mount errors or hook mistakes could still surface at runtime.
known_limitations.orchestrator_default_branch: Repo has no `main` branch. Default remote HEAD is `feat/refactor-solution-page-hygraph`. Full orchestrator runs must be given the correct baseBranch; the default 'main' will fail with 'fatal: bad revision'. Recommend updating OrchestratorPanel default value.
known_limitations.management_token_absent: HYGRAPH_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN is empty in .env.local. cms-injector can lookup and draft mutations but cannot APPLY them until an operator adds a management token. Preview mode works fully without it.
known_limitations.long_desc_across_site: All 65 crawled pages have a 208-char description (over the 160-char cap). This is the site's default meta description template, not per-page copy. Fix requires either: (a) shortening the default template, or (b) per-page description generation for every route — a much bigger effort than SEO polish on individual pages.
known_limitations.cms_visible_models_zero_use_cases_case_s: The page-index shows UseCase=0 and CaseStudy=0 CMS-owned pages, even though the models exist in Hygraph. Likely the dist crawler doesn't find any /use-cases/* or /case-studies/* routes in the built site — they may be under a different prefix, or the CMS records may not be published, or the routes may be dynamically generated at request time and thus absent from the prerendered dist.
known_limitations.gemini_free_tier_quota: Same 20 req/day/model limit from round 4 still applies. cms-injector avoids this by only calling Gemini via analyst; a full orchestrator pass with many candidates will hit quota.

recommended_next_rounds.round_6a_fix_default_description: Locate the default 208-char meta description template. Replace it with a short SEO-safe generic (60-140 chars) so uncustomized pages stop being flagged as long_desc. This single change flips 65 flagged pages to clean.
recommended_next_rounds.round_6b_apply_flag_end_to_end: Provision HYGRAPH_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN, then run cms-injector with --apply on the spaCy proposal that's already sitting in round4-2026-07-07T1852's queue. Verify the mutation lands, page rebuilds, and the flat description update propagates to prod.
recommended_next_rounds.round_6c_page_index_source_bug: Investigate why UseCase and CaseStudy models have 0 pages in the crawler even though Hygraph has records. Might be a route prefix mismatch, a missing prerender step, or the routes require login (unlikely).
recommended_next_rounds.round_6d_deploy_backend: The seo-agent-server currently runs on the operator's laptop. Move to a durable host (Vercel serverless functions won't work — needs long-lived SSE connections and process spawning. Fly.io or a small Render service fits). Update the frontend VITE_SEO_AGENT_BASE env when deployed.
recommended_next_rounds.round_6e_slack_notifications: Wire orchestrator runs to post start/complete/fail into a Slack channel so the operator doesn't have to keep the dashboard open.
